newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE forecasts GDP at $43.4 bln in 1998 - paper.
newsitem.headline: UAE forecasts GDP at $43.4 bln in 1998 - paper.

text.p: The oil-rich United Arab Emirates expects gross domestic product (GDP) to grow to $43.4 billion in 1998 from a forecast $40.6 billion this year, a newspaper said on Wednesday.
The Al-Ittihad newspaper, quoting a report from the office of Abu Dhabi's crown prince, said real growth of 2.2 percent was expected this year, with 2.7 percent seen in 1997 and 2.2 percent in 1998.
The report forecast UAE exports of $25.1 billion this year, $26.1 billion in 1997 and $26.9 billion in 1998. Imports were seen at $21.2 billion, $22.3 billion and $23.4 billion, respectively.
The study expects per capita income in the seven-member federation of $16,250 in 1996, $16,160 in 1997 and $16,230 in 1998.

Total state revenue of $12.5 billion, $13.3 billion and $13.8 billion is expected over the three respective years. The OPEC-member's oil earnings were seen at $9.5 billion this year, rising to $9.8 billion in 1997 and $10 billion in 1998.
The study put total state spending at $15.5 billion this year, $15.8 billion in 1997 and $16.1 billion in 1998.
It said demand for electricity was expected to rise to 8,000 megawatts by the year 2000 from 6,370 MW this year and 7,330 MW in 1997.
